title: GEMglEvalCoord1d
description: evaluate enabled one- and two-dimensional maps

messages.description: value of the first domain coordinate

arguments.description: value of the first domain coordinate

body: [GEMglEvalCoord1d] calls glEvalCoord1d() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glEvalCoord in the OpenGL reference.
